table.prompt: Seen straight down from above: a large pale warm-grey self-healing cutting mat with a faint printed grid on a studio table, soft diagonal shadows of a window frame falling across it, late-afternoon light.

venue.prompt: A fashion show venue in near darkness: a long glossy black runway floor receding into the distance, soft haze in the air, a row of small warm spotlights high above as bokeh.

fog.prompt: Low-lying stage fog rolling across the floor of a dark fashion runway, soft white wisps and drifting haze, thickest along the bottom of the frame and thinning out upward, isolated on a plain pure black background, photographic, soft edges.

cobalt-tissue.prompt: Seen straight down from above: a large sheet of deep cobalt-blue tissue paper, crumpled and then smoothed flat again, a fine network of soft creases catching soft daylight, calm and even, the paper fills the whole frame from edge to edge.
